content.short: Cede.store is a non-custodial extension that lets apps connect exchange accounts and use CeFi balances through wallet-style flows.
content.description: Cede.store is a non-custodial browser extension and integration layer designed to connect centralized exchange accounts to decentralized applications without handing control of funds to a third party. According to its docs, users store exchange API keys inside the extension and approve exchange actions client-side, while apps can read balances, manage assets, and trigger supported actions through provider packages or widgets. The product is built to give DeFi apps access to CeFi liquidity with a wallet-like user experience and developer tooling that feels familiar to Web3 integrations.
content.meta: Explore Cede.store, a non-custodial extension that connects exchange accounts to DeFi apps through wallet-style flows and APIs.
